race.comment: SUN GIFT (4) missed by 1L at Cranbourne two back before a 1.5L defeat in the Tesio Stakes at Flemington. Back to this level is a big tick for her and if she gets some luck in running, she can make her presence felt. PRINCE ERIC (2) flew late in the Coongy after settling back in the run. Back to a country cup now and the inside draw helps. Can land in a handy position and will take beating on his last start effort. THE PENDRAGON (1) was too good at Horsham last start and the form out of that has stood up. Lane rides now and there's no reason why he can't repeat the dose. YAHOO BAR (10) has been close his past couple and looks well placed here with the blinkers going on as he drops back in trip. Has to be included.
